verdict.rationale: Retell's built-in AI assistant, Conductor, drafts an agent from a plain-English description and edits prompts, settings and conversation flows on request, with changes proposed for review before applying. It can also run simulation tests that play scenarios against the agent. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Conductor generates reusable graded test cases from a description (evidence only shows it running simulation scenarios), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Conductor's authoring quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description

citations.quote: click **Generate from prompt** (marked Suggested) to let [Conductor](/conductor/create-agent) draft an agent from a plain-English description of your use case
Ask Conductor to change your agent's prompts, settings, or conversation flow in plain language. It proposes edits for you to review before applying them.
Conductor can run simulation tests that play out a scenario against your agent and show how it responds.
Conductor is Retell's AI assistant for building agents, investigating conversations, and improving analytics dashboards.
